traceability.notes: The story docs/stories/007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING.story.md defines conventions and requirements for clear, consistent, and actionable error messages across all traceability validation rules. The corresponding ESLint rules implement message templates using ESLint’s meta.messages with appropriate placeholders (function name, paths, requirement IDs, details) and recommended severities. Tests explicitly tied to this story (tests/rules/error-reporting.test.ts and tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts) verify REQ-ERROR-SPECIFIC, REQ-ERROR-SUGGESTION, REQ-ERROR-CONTEXT, REQ-ERROR-LOCATION, and REQ-ERROR-SEVERITY. All related rule tests pass in the full Jest run. No discrepancies were found between the specification and the implementation, so this story is fully implemented and verified.
